description: UI step after backend: Labels page Values & usage entry, shared modal/component with bounded searchable values including Empty value, usage counts, matching document/chunk rows, current-page selection and explicit selected-count update/clear confirmation. Reuse DSM Table/Input/Button, BOModal, LabelEvents NodeRouter; no direct domain calls or new styling system. Tests before implementation: real LiveView open usage/select value/resources/save/clear/cancel, pagination resets selection, errors retain state, readonly no mutation. Existing test contracts preserved. Update BO docs and Storybook if reusable presentation extracted. Deferred feature E2E scenarios in zaq-kw0.16 after zaq-kw0.15 approval; no new journey specs now. All operations consume backend prerequisite Action through ingestion events.

comments.text: Implemented catalog Values / usage counts and LabelValueManager using existing DSM Table/Input/Button and viewport-bounded BOModal shell. Values page searchable; resource selection limited to current 50-row page, readonly rows disabled, explicit selected-count confirmation for replacement or clearing, errors retain proposal and provide reload. Formatted and lint clean. Existing catalog/table regression tests and new real LiveView tests passed in combined 57-check run. No local BO server on port 4000, so browser visual verification not performed. Final feature UX/E2E gate remains separate; no commit authorized.

Follow-up visual correction: usage metrics are separate non-wrapping spans in a wrapping flex container, so count and noun stay together; resources moves to its own line when needed. Removed dot separator to avoid a stranded separator on wrap. Correct singular resource wording. Action reuse not applicable: presentation-only. mix q passed.
